name: ChatSession
description: Captures the complete transcript of a conversation session with a Mastra-powered AI agent, including system prompts, multi-modal user input, assistant responses, multi-step tool use, reasoning, and error states. Operations are split by actor role (system, user, agent, tool) for permission enforcement.

global.schema:
enum SessionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  COMPLETED
  ABORTED
  ERROR
}

enum MessageRole {
  SYSTEM
  USER
  ASSISTANT
  TOOL
}

enum ContentPartType {
  TEXT
  IMAGE
  FILE
  TOOL_CALL
  TOOL_RESULT
  REASONING
  ERROR
}

type AgentInfo {
  id: String
  name: String
  model: String
  description: String
  attachment: String
}

type MessageUsage {
  promptTokens: Int
  completionTokens: Int
  totalTokens: Int
}

type UsageSummary {
  totalPromptTokens: Int!
  totalCompletionTokens: Int!
  totalTokens: Int!
  totalSteps: Int!
  totalMessages: Int!
  totalToolCalls: Int!
}

type ContentPart {
  id: OID!
  type: ContentPartType!
  text: String
  toolCallId: String
  toolName: String
  args: String
  result: String
  isError: Boolean
  mediaType: String
  url: URL
  attachment: String
  filename: String
  error: String
}

type TurnFailure {
  userMessageId: OID!
  code: String!
  message: String!
  retryable: Boolean!
  failedAt: DateTime!
}

type Message {
  id: OID!
  role: MessageRole!
  content: [ContentPart!]!
  stepIndex: Int
  createdAt: DateTime!
  usage: MessageUsage
  finishedAt: DateTime
  finishReason: String
  pickedUpAt: DateTime
  failure: TurnFailure
}

type ChatSessionState {
  threadId: String
  resourceId: String
  agent: AgentInfo
  status: SessionStatus!
  startedAt: DateTime
  endedAt: DateTime
  messages: [Message!]!
  usage: UsageSummary
  interruptRequested: Boolean
  retryRequestedFor: OID
  retryRequestedAt: DateTime
}
global.initialValue: {"threadId": null, "resourceId": null, "agent": null, "status": "ACTIVE", "startedAt": null, "endedAt": null, "messages": [], "usage": null, "interruptRequested": false, "retryRequestedFor": null, "retryRequestedAt": null}

modules.name: system
modules.description: Session lifecycle and framework-level operations. Controlled by the system/admin actor.

operations.name: START_SESSION
operations.description: Initialize a chat session with thread ID, resource ID, agent info, and start timestamp. Sets status to ACTIVE.
operations.template: Initialize a chat session with thread ID, resource ID, agent info, and start timestamp. Sets status to ACTIVE.

operations.name: SET_AGENT_INFO
operations.description: Update agent configuration (id, name, model, instructions).
operations.template: Update agent configuration (id, name, model, instructions).

operations.name: END_SESSION
operations.description: Mark the session as completed or errored with an end timestamp.
operations.template: Mark the session as completed or errored with an end timestamp.
operations.reducer:
state.status = action.input.status;
state.endedAt = action.input.endedAt;

operations.name: UPDATE_USAGE_SUMMARY
operations.description: Update cumulative token usage and message/tool-call counts for the session.
operations.schema:
input UpdateUsageSummaryInput {
  totalPromptTokens: Int
  totalCompletionTokens: Int
  totalTokens: Int
  totalSteps: Int
  totalMessages: Int
  totalToolCalls: Int
}
operations.template: Update cumulative token usage and message/tool-call counts for the session.

operations.name: ADD_SYSTEM_MESSAGE
operations.description: Add a system prompt or instruction message to the conversation.
operations.template: Add a system prompt or instruction message to the conversation.
operations.reducer:
state.messages.push({
  id: action.input.id,
  role: 'SYSTEM',
  content: [{
    id: action.input.id + '-text',
    type: 'TEXT',
    text: action.input.text,
    toolCallId: null,
    toolName: null,
    args: null,
    result: null,
    isError: null,
    mediaType: null,
    url: null,
    attachment: null,
    filename: null,
    error: null,
  }],
  stepIndex: null,
  createdAt: action.input.createdAt,
  usage: null,
  finishedAt: null,
  finishReason: null,
  pickedUpAt: null,
  failure: null,
});
if (state.usage) state.usage.totalMessages += 1;

operations.name: SET_AGENT_IMAGE
operations.description: Set or clear the agent avatar attachment ref.
operations.template: Set or clear the agent avatar attachment ref.

operations.name: SET_AGENT_DESCRIPTION
operations.description: Set or update the agent description text.
operations.template: Set or update the agent description text.

modules.name: user
modules.description: Human user operations: sending messages, deleting own messages, aborting the session.

operations.name: ADD_USER_MESSAGE
operations.description: Add a user message with text, image, and/or file content parts.
operations.schema:
input UserContentPartInput {
  id: OID!
  type: ContentPartType!
  text: String
  mediaType: String
  url: URL
  attachment: String
  filename: String
}

input AddUserMessageInput {
  id: OID!
  content: [UserContentPartInput!]!
  createdAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Add a user message with text, image, and/or file content parts.

errors.name: InvalidContentPartError
errors.description: A content part is missing required fields for its type (e.g. TEXT without text).

operations.name: DELETE_USER_MESSAGE
operations.description: Remove a user message by ID. Only messages with role USER can be deleted.
operations.template: Remove a user message by ID. Only messages with role USER can be deleted.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.

errors.name: NotUserMessageError
errors.description: Only messages with role USER can be deleted via this operation.

operations.name: ABORT_SESSION
operations.description: User-initiated session abort. Sets status to ABORTED with end timestamp.
operations.template: User-initiated session abort. Sets status to ABORTED with end timestamp.
operations.reducer:
state.status = 'ABORTED';
state.endedAt = action.input.endedAt;

operations.name: INTERRUPT_AGENT
operations.description: User-initiated interrupt of the in-flight agent turn. Sets interruptRequested so the agent watcher aborts the current stream. The session stays ACTIVE so the user can keep chatting.
operations.template: User-initiated interrupt of the in-flight agent turn. Sets interruptRequested so the agent watcher aborts the current stream. The session stays ACTIVE so the user can keep chatting.
operations.reducer: state.interruptRequested = true;

operations.name: RETRY_TURN
operations.description: Ask the agent to run the turn for a user message again (e.g. after a failed turn). Sets retryRequestedFor; the agent clears it with CLEAR_RETRY_REQUEST once it picks the retry up.
operations.template: Ask the agent to run the turn for a user message again (e.g. after a failed turn). Sets retryRequestedFor; the agent clears it with CLEAR_RETRY_REQUEST once it picks the retry up.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The user message to retry does not exist in the session.

errors.name: NotUserMessageError
errors.description: Only the turn of a USER message can be retried.

operations.name: RESUME_SESSION
operations.description: Reopen a session that ended in ERROR. Sets status back to ACTIVE and clears endedAt; messages and usage are kept.
operations.template: Reopen a session that ended in ERROR. Sets status back to ACTIVE and clears endedAt; messages and usage are kept.

errors.name: SessionNotResumableError
errors.description: Only sessions with status ERROR can be resumed.

modules.name: agent
modules.description: LLM/assistant operations: adding responses, streaming content parts, recording token usage.

operations.name: ADD_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE
operations.description: Add a complete assistant message with text, tool calls, reasoning, and/or file content parts.
operations.schema:
input AssistantContentPartInput {
  id: OID!
  type: ContentPartType!
  text: String
  toolCallId: String
  toolName: String
  args: String
  mediaType: String
  url: URL
  attachment: String
  filename: String
  error: String
}

input AddAssistantMessageInput {
  id: OID!
  content: [AssistantContentPartInput!]!
  stepIndex: Int
  createdAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Add a complete assistant message with text, tool calls, reasoning, and/or file content parts.

errors.name: InvalidContentPartError
errors.description: A content part is missing required fields for its type (e.g. TEXT without text, TOOL_CALL without toolCallId).

operations.name: APPEND_ASSISTANT_CONTENT
operations.description: Add a content part to an existing assistant message. Used during streaming to build up a message incrementally.
operations.template: Add a content part to an existing assistant message. Used during streaming to build up a message incrementally.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.

errors.name: NotAssistantMessageError
errors.description: Content can only be appended to messages with role ASSISTANT.

errors.name: InvalidContentPartError
errors.description: A content part is missing required fields for its type (e.g. TEXT without text, TOOL_CALL without toolCallId).

operations.name: UPDATE_ASSISTANT_CONTENT
operations.description: Update an existing content part within an assistant message. Used to accumulate streamed text deltas.
operations.schema:
input UpdateAssistantContentInput {
  messageId: OID!
  partId: OID!
  text: String
  args: String
  error: String
}
operations.template: Update an existing content part within an assistant message. Used to accumulate streamed text deltas.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.

errors.name: ContentPartNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified content part ID does not exist in the message.

operations.name: SET_MESSAGE_USAGE
operations.description: Record token usage for a specific message.
operations.template: Record token usage for a specific message.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.

operations.name: FINISH_ASSISTANT_MESSAGE
operations.description: Mark an assistant message as the final message of the agent's turn.
operations.template: Mark an assistant message as the final message of the agent's turn.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.

operations.name: MARK_MESSAGE_PICKED_UP
operations.description: The agent records that it picked up a user message and is starting its turn.
operations.template: The agent records that it picked up a user message and is starting its turn.

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The message to mark as picked up does not exist in the session.

operations.name: FAIL_TURN
operations.description: The agent turn for a user message failed. Appends a finished ASSISTANT message with an ERROR part and the failure details. The session stays ACTIVE so the user can retry or keep chatting.
operations.schema:
input FailTurnInput {
  id: OID!
  userMessageId: OID!
  code: String!
  message: String!
  retryable: Boolean!
  failedAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: The agent turn for a user message failed. Appends a finished ASSISTANT message with an ERROR part and the failure details. The session stays ACTIVE so the user can retry or keep chatting.
operations.reducer:
state.messages.push({
  id: action.input.id,
  role: 'ASSISTANT',
  content: [
    {
      id: action.input.id + '-error',
      type: 'ERROR',
      text: null,
      toolCallId: null,
      toolName: null,
      args: null,
      result: null,
      isError: null,
      mediaType: null,
      url: null,
      attachment: null,
      filename: null,
      error: action.input.message,
    },
  ],
  stepIndex: null,
  createdAt: action.input.failedAt,
  usage: null,
  finishedAt: action.input.failedAt,
  finishReason: 'error',
  pickedUpAt: null,
  failure: {
    userMessageId: action.input.userMessageId,
    code: action.input.code,
    message: action.input.message,
    retryable: action.input.retryable,
    failedAt: action.input.failedAt,
  },
});
if (state.usage) state.usage.totalMessages += 1;

operations.name: CLEAR_RETRY_REQUEST
operations.description: The agent acknowledges a retry request by clearing retryRequestedFor before it re-runs the turn.
operations.template: The agent acknowledges a retry request by clearing retryRequestedFor before it re-runs the turn.
operations.reducer:
state.retryRequestedFor = null;
state.retryRequestedAt = null;

modules.name: tool
modules.description: Tool executor operations: returning tool results and progressive output.

operations.name: ADD_TOOL_RESULT
operations.description: Add a tool result message containing one or more result parts (success or error). Links back to a tool call via toolCallId.
operations.schema:
input ToolResultPartInput {
  id: OID!
  type: ContentPartType!
  toolCallId: String!
  toolName: String!
  result: String
  isError: Boolean
  text: String
  mediaType: String
  url: URL
  attachment: String
}

input AddToolResultInput {
  id: OID!
  content: [ToolResultPartInput!]!
  stepIndex: Int
  createdAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Add a tool result message containing one or more result parts (success or error). Links back to a tool call via toolCallId.
operations.reducer:
const parts = action.input.content.map(p => ({
  id: p.id,
  type: p.type,
  text: p.text || null,
  toolCallId: p.toolCallId,
  toolName: p.toolName,
  args: null,
  result: p.result || null,
  isError: p.isError ?? null,
  mediaType: p.mediaType || null,
  url: p.url || null,
  attachment: p.attachment || null,
  filename: null,
  error: null,
}));
state.messages.push({
  id: action.input.id,
  role: 'TOOL',
  content: parts,
  stepIndex: action.input.stepIndex ?? null,
  createdAt: action.input.createdAt,
  usage: null,
  finishedAt: null,
  finishReason: null,
  pickedUpAt: null,
  failure: null,
});
if (state.usage) state.usage.totalMessages += 1;

operations.name: ADD_TOOL_OUTPUT
operations.description: Add progressive output from a running tool. Appends a TEXT content part to an existing tool message.
operations.schema:
input AddToolOutputInput {
  messageId: OID!
  partId: OID!
  toolCallId: String!
  toolName: String!
  text: String!
}
operations.template: Add progressive output from a running tool. Appends a TEXT content part to an existing tool message.
operations.reducer:
const msg = state.messages.find(m => m.id === action.input.messageId);
if (!msg) throw new MessageNotFoundError('Message not found: ' + action.input.messageId);
msg.content.push({
  id: action.input.partId,
  type: 'TEXT',
  text: action.input.text,
  toolCallId: action.input.toolCallId,
  toolName: action.input.toolName,
  args: null,
  result: null,
  isError: null,
  mediaType: null,
  url: null,
  attachment: null,
  filename: null,
  error: null,
});

errors.name: MessageNotFoundError
errors.description: The specified message ID does not exist in the session.
